subject.title: exec private-LAN access fails while same user GUI/LaunchAgent succeeds

question: Should this issue be resolved with a diagnostic-only exec warning, or should OpenClaw change gateway-host exec private-LAN reachability semantics?
rationale: Source inspection can prove the missing diagnostic, but allowing, blocking, or detaching private-LAN exec traffic changes a security boundary and needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Land Diagnostic Only
options.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while keeping broader private-network access policy in the related security trackers.

options.title: Design Access Parity
options.body: Treat same-user GUI/LaunchAgent reachability as the product goal and require a separate security design before implementation.

options.title: Defer To Policy Trackers
options.body: Reject the diagnostic-only scope and keep this behavior under the broader private-network policy issues.

recommendation.title: Land Diagnostic Only
recommendation.body: Review and land the open diagnostic PR while keeping broader private-network access policy in the related security trackers.

likelyOwner.reason: The exec runtime, docs, approval, and host-routing history most consistently routes this policy choice to steipete.
